text: “For I zid you kissing his shade.” ”What did you see her doing?” asked Marian. “Why—he was standing over the whey-tub to let off the whey, and the shade of his face came upon the wall behind, close to Izz, who was standing there filling a vat. She put her mouth against the wall and kissed the shade of his mouth; I zid her, though he didn’t.” “O Izz Huett!” said Marian. A rosy spot came into the middle of Izz Huett’s cheek. “Well, there was no harm in it,” she declared, with attempted coolness.
